```typescript
  input: FlintCompileInput,
  mode: FlintVmExecutionMode,
  options: FlintSelfHostedRunOptions = {},
): FlintSelfHostedVmRun;
```

Run the bounded self-hosted compiler bootstrap.

Executes the FWS lex and parser stages under the requested VM mode and
compares each VM-derived fingerprint against the independent seed reference.
Full Wasm emission remains seed-backed and is exposed via `artifact` only when
every stage reports parity.

### createFlintWorkerScheduler

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function createFlintWorkerScheduler(options: FlintWorkerSchedulerOptions = {}): FlintWorkerScheduler;
```

Creates the host-side scheduling boundary used by parallel iterator operations.

Work is still represented by a local callback because arbitrary JS callbacks cannot
be transferred to a Worker. A host integration may provide worker runtimes for
lifecycle/cleanup and use the indexed protocol at its boundary; this scheduler
provides the same bounded async contract for hosts without worker support.

#### Parameters

| Name    | Type                        | Description |
| ------- | --------------------------- | ----------- |
| options | FlintWorkerSchedulerOptions |             |
